chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Abu Sa'id from Mansur from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): When the person in Ihram touches his beard and hair falls from it, he said: He gives a handful of food or two handfuls.

key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: The person in the state of Ihram (ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah)

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for accidentally losing beard hair while in Ihram?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Istibsar clarifies the fidya for accidentally removing beard hair while in Ihram, prescribing the feeding of one or two handfuls of food to the poor. It reflects the Shia juristic view on minor breaches of Ihram restrictions, distinguishing between intentional and accidental acts, and underscores the practical application of expiation in ritual purity and devotion.
